senses.gloss: ख्या [cf. Lat. in-quam, &c.]
ख्यात mfn. named, called, denominated, MBh. &c.
known, well known, celebrated, notorious, ib.
told, W.
ख्यात—गर्हण mfn. having a bad name or evil report, notoriously vile, L.
ख्यात—गर्हित mfn. id., L.
ख्यात—विरुद्ध-ता for ख्याति-व्˚, q.v.
ख्यातव्य mfn. to be styled or called, W.
to be told, W.
to be celebrated, W.
ख्याति f. ‘declaration’, opinion, view, idea, assertion, BhP. xi, 16, 24; Sarvad. xv, 201
perception, knowledge, Yogas.; Tattvas. (= बुद्धि), Sarvad.
renown, fame, celebrity, Mn. xii, 36; MBh. iii, 8273; R. &c.
a name, denomination, title, MBh. i
xiv; R. iii, 4, 17
Celebrity (personified as daughter of Dakṣa, VP. i, 7, 23; 8, 14 f.; 9 f.; or of Kardama, BhP. iii, 24, 23), Hariv. 7740
N. of a river in Krauñca-dvīpa, VP. ii, 4, 55
ख्याति m. N. of a son of Ūru by Āgneyī (v.l. स्वाति), Hariv. 73; VP. i
of a son of the 4th Manu, BhP. viii, 1, 27.
ख्याति—कर mfn. causing renown, glorious, W.
ख्याति—जनक mfn. id., W.
ख्याति—घ्न mfn. destroying reputation, disgraceful, W.
ख्याति—बोध m. sense of honour, W.
ख्याति—मत् mfn. renowned, Kathās.
ख्याति—विरुद्ध-ता f. (v.l. ख्यात-व्˚) the state of being contradictory to general opinion (a defect of expression in rhet.), Sāh. vii, 10 and 22.
ख्यान n. perception, knowledge, KapS. v, 52.
ख्यापक mfn. ifc. making known or declaring, indicative, Suśr.; Sāh. vi, 60
one who confesses, W.
ख्यापन n. declaring, divulging, making known, Kathās. lxi, 258
confessing, public confession, Mn. xi, 228; MBh.; MārkP.
making renowned, celebrating, Rājat. v, 160.
ख्यापनीय mfn. to be declared, Nyāyad., Sch.
ख्यापित mfn. declared, denounced, MBh. xiii, 4055
praised, R. iii, 27, 19; BhP. iv, 17, 1.
ख्यापिन् mfn. ifc. making known, Kathās. lxxvii, 15.
ख्याप्य mfn. to be related, MBh. iii, 12406.
